subject.title: fix(auto-reply): older completed replies stall or vanish when a follow-up message starts a long turn

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally release an older completed reply after 20 seconds when a newer same-target turn is still active but has not produced any visible reply?
rationale: The branch trades indefinite silence for bounded chronological delivery, but the chosen timeout changes the established freshness/ordering policy across visible-reply channels and is not determined solely by correctness tests.

options.title: Adopt the bounded release policy
options.body: Accept a documented 20-second settlement window, contingent on exact-head live proof that visible-winner suppression remains intact.

options.title: Use a different policy boundary
options.body: Keep the current suppression behavior or choose another owner-approved timeout/condition before implementation is accepted.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded release policy
recommendation.body: Accept a documented 20-second settlement window, contingent on exact-head live proof that visible-winner suppression remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged adjacent foreground-fence repair indicates the strongest available ownership connection to the delivery policy.
